components_with_pn_and_sn_confirmed.plain_explanation: Share of components that have both a confirmed part number and a confirmed serial number — the basis for traceable identity.

components_with_pn_only.plain_explanation: Components with a part number but no serial number.
components_with_pn_only.justification: Derived from graph state. numerator: MATCH (c:Component)-[:HAS_PRIMARY_PN]->() WHERE NOT (c)-[:HAS_SN]->() RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS n; denominator: MATCH (c:Component) RETURN count(c) AS n

components_with_sn_only.plain_explanation: Components with a serial number but no part number.
components_with_sn_only.justification: Derived from graph state. numerator: MATCH (c:Component)-[:HAS_SN]->() WHERE NOT (c)-[:HAS_PRIMARY_PN]->() RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS n; denominator: MATCH (c:Component) RETURN count(c) AS n

components_with_neither_pn_nor_sn.plain_explanation: Components with neither a part number nor a serial number — low traceability; review whether they should be in scope.
components_with_neither_pn_nor_sn.justification: Derived from graph state. numerator: MATCH (c:Component) WHERE NOT (c)-[:HAS_PRIMARY_PN]->() AND NOT (c)-[:HAS_SN]->() RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS n; denominator: MATCH (c:Component) RETURN count(c) AS n

total_source_files_ingested.plain_explanation: Total distinct source documents ingested into the audit graph.
total_source_files_ingested.justification: Derived from graph state via Cypher: MATCH (d:Document) RETURN count(d) AS n

total_chunks_processed.plain_explanation: Total page chunks processed (one per row of the corpus.csv).
total_chunks_processed.justification: Derived from graph state via Cypher: MATCH (p:Page) RETURN count(p) AS n

physical_records_and_mts_exports_disting.plain_explanation: Physical records and MTS exports are distinguished in the graph via the Document.source_kind property.

mts_data_points_flagged_separately.plain_explanation: MTS data points are flagged separately from physical-record data points.

components_with_all_six_key_fields.plain_explanation: Share of components carrying all six key fields (PN, SN, position, TSN, CSN, Form 1).
components_with_all_six_key_fields.justification: Derived from graph state. numerator: MATCH (c:Component) WHERE (c)-[:HAS_PRIMARY_PN]->() AND (c)-[:HAS_SN]->() AND coalesce(c.position, '') <> '' AND c.tsn_at_event IS NOT NULL AND c.csn_at_event IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS { MATCH (:Form1)-[; denominator: MATCH (c:Component) RETURN count(c) AS n

missing_fields_identified_for_each_compo.plain_explanation: For every component with a missing key field, the dashboard's per-component block names which field is absent.
missing_fields_identified_for_each_compo.justification: Per-component completeness is computed in §6 / §7 / §8 modules.

context_discrepancies_detected.plain_explanation: Components where on-page values contradict known asset context. Currently surfaces components missing CSN-at-event (the LLP unresolvable rule trigger).
context_discrepancies_detected.justification: Derived from graph state via Cypher: MATCH (c:Component) WHERE c.status = 'PARTIAL' AND c.csn_at_event IS NULL RETURN count(c) AS n

each_discrepancy_described_and_flagged.plain_explanation: Each discrepancy is described in the component-level finding it generates.
each_discrepancy_described_and_flagged.justification: Findings carry full description + recommended_action per SKILL.md §13.

singleton_nodes_with_no_connections.plain_explanation: Singleton nodes — nodes with no connections. Expected to be 0; any greater value suggests an extraction or pass error.
singleton_nodes_with_no_connections.justification: Derived from graph state via Cypher: MATCH (n) WHERE NOT (n)--() RETURN count(n) AS n

orphan_documents.plain_explanation: Documents with no associated pages. Expected 0; greater values indicate extraction issues or empty documents.
orphan_documents.justification: Derived from graph state via Cypher: MATCH (d:Document) WHERE NOT (d)-[:HAS_PAGE]->() RETURN count(d) AS n

cross_references_resolved.plain_explanation: Share of mention edges where the target connector node was successfully resolved.
cross_references_resolved.justification: Derived from graph state. numerator: MATCH (m)-[:MENTIONS_PN|MENTIONS_SN|MENTIONS_WO|MENTIONS_TC|MENTIONS_NRC|MENTIONS_SB|MENTIONS_AD|MENTIONS_EO|MENTIONS_MOD|MENTIONS_STC|REFS|CITES]->(target) RETURN count(target) AS n; denominator: MATCH (m)-[:MENTIONS_PN|MENTIONS_SN|MENTIONS_WO|MENTIONS_TC|MENTIONS_NRC|MENTIONS_SB|MENTIONS_AD|MENTIONS_EO|MENTIONS_MOD|MENTIONS_STC|REFS|CITES]->(target) RETURN count(target) AS n

tsn_csn_baseline_confidence.plain_explanation: Confidence in the TSN/CSN baseline (the airframe state at dossier cut-off). 'Verified' means at least one snapshot ties Asset state to a primary record; 'Config_fallback' means we used brief values as the baseline; 'Unknown' means no baseline could be established.
tsn_csn_baseline_confidence.justification: baseline_check: Asset present AND at least one ComponentSnapshot exists

tsn_csn_baseline_discrepancy_source_iden.plain_explanation: No discrepancy between configured baseline and observed snapshots.
tsn_csn_baseline_discrepancy_source_iden.justification: (Phase F.4 will refine: cross-checks airframe TSN/CSN against last logbook entry.)

batch_numbers_for_non_serialised_parts.plain_explanation: Distinct batch numbers found in the dossier (used to consolidate FORM1_MISSING findings when a batch certificate covers a serial range).
batch_numbers_for_non_serialised_parts.justification: Derived from graph state via Cypher: MATCH (b:BatchNumber) RETURN count(b) AS n

batch_numbers_linked_to_install_records.plain_explanation: Share of batch numbers successfully linked to an installed component.
batch_numbers_linked_to_install_records.justification: Derived from graph state. numerator: MATCH (b:BatchNumber)-[:RELATES_TO]->(:Component) RETURN count(DISTINCT b) AS n; denominator: MATCH (b:BatchNumber) RETURN count(b) AS n

evidentiary_weight_assessed_for_all_docu.plain_explanation: Every document is classified into an evidence class (primary / secondary / administrative / reference).
evidentiary_weight_assessed_for_all_docu.justification: At least one match found via Cypher: MATCH (d:Document) WHERE coalesce(d.evidence_class, '') <> '' RETURN count(d) AS n

documents_classified_into_evidence_class.plain_explanation: Every document is classified into an evidence class (primary / secondary / administrative / reference).
documents_classified_into_evidence_class.justification: At least one match found via Cypher: MATCH (d:Document) WHERE coalesce(d.evidence_class, '') <> '' RETURN count(d) AS n

secondary_or_administrative_evidence_fin.plain_explanation: Findings sourced from secondary or administrative evidence are flagged for cross-verification against primary records.
secondary_or_administrative_evidence_fin.justification: Per SKILL.md §6, findings derived solely from secondary/administrative weight raise their severity by one tier or recommend primary-source verification.

stamp_binding_and_spatial_context_verifi.plain_explanation: Stamp binding and spatial context have been processed for every stamp in the dossier.

all_stamps_correctly_bound.plain_explanation: Every stamp is bound to its target evidence record with no ambiguity.

stamps_with_ambiguous_binding_flagged.plain_explanation: Stamps whose binding to a single evidence record is ambiguous (page has multiple candidate targets).
stamps_with_ambiguous_binding_flagged.justification: Derived from graph state via Cypher: MATCH (s:Stamp) WHERE s.binding_status = 'ambiguous' RETURN count(s) AS n

stamps_with_no_binding_target.plain_explanation: Stamps with no binding target. Expected 0; greater values flagged for review.
stamps_with_no_binding_target.justification: Derived from graph state via Cypher: MATCH (s:Stamp) WHERE s.binding_status = 'unbound' RETURN count(s) AS n

scan_quality_and_rotation_assessed_for_a.plain_explanation: Scan quality and rotation have been assessed for every page in the dossier.
scan_quality_and_rotation_assessed_for_a.justification: 13809 pages assessed; 0 flagged with rotation issues; 0 flagged with poor scan quality.

pages_with_rotation_issues.plain_explanation: Pages with rotation issues. Expected 0; greater means upstream extractor needs to apply rotation correction.
pages_with_rotation_issues.justification: Derived from graph state via Cypher: MATCH (p:Page) WHERE p.rotation_deg IS NOT NULL AND p.rotation_deg <> 0 RETURN count(p) AS n

rotation_corrected_before_extraction.plain_explanation: Pages with rotation issues have been corrected before extraction.

pages_with_poor_scan_quality.plain_explanation: Pages with poor scan quality (blank or template-empty). Expected 0.
pages_with_poor_scan_quality.justification: Derived from graph state via Cypher: MATCH (p:Page) WHERE coalesce(p.is_blank, false) = true OR coalesce(p.is_template_empty, false) = true RETURN count(p) AS n

poor_quality_pages_flagged_for_manual_re.plain_explanation: Poor-quality pages are flagged for manual review.

documents_complete.plain_explanation: Share of the 10 expected key-document categories present in the dossier (AFM, ADs, SBs, mods, STCs, release-to-service, logbook, task cards, test reports, W&B). A category is satisfied if any document_type in its accepted list is present.
documents_complete.justification: Derived from graph state. Found (8/10): aircraft_flight_manual, airworthiness_directives, service_bulletins, modifications, stcs, release_to_service, logbook, test_reports. Missing: task_cards, weight_and_balance.

component_data_complete.plain_explanation: Share of components with the minimum traceable identity: Part Number + Serial Number + at least one evidence-page anchor. Lukas's Dimension 1 — without the SN, nothing else can be verified.
component_data_complete.justification: Derived from graph state. numerator: MATCH (c:Component) WHERE (c)-[:HAS_PRIMARY_PN]->() AND (c)-[:HAS_SN]->() AND EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:MENTIONED_ON]->(:Page) } RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS n; denominator: MATCH (c:Component) RETURN count(c) AS n

ad_compliance_complete.plain_explanation: Share of applicable Airworthiness Directives that have a compliance record — either an explicit COMPLIES_WITH link OR a mention on an AD-status-report Document. AD compliance is mandatory per SKILL.md §4.5.
ad_compliance_complete.justification: Derived from graph state. numerator: MATCH (a:AirworthinessDirective) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (d:Document {is_status_source: true})-[:HAS_PAGE]->(p:Page)-[:MENTIONS_AD]->(a) } OR EXISTS { MATCH (a)<-[:COMPLIES_WITH]-() } RETURN count(DISTIN; denominator: MATCH (a:AirworthinessDirective) RETURN count(a) AS n

sb_compliance_complete.plain_explanation: Share of applicable Service Bulletins evidenced by an SB-status-report mention or explicit compliance record.
sb_compliance_complete.justification: Derived from graph state. numerator: MATCH (s:ServiceBulletin) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (d:Document {is_status_source: true})-[:HAS_PAGE]->(p:Page)-[:MENTIONS_SB]->(s) } OR EXISTS { MATCH (s)<-[:COMPLIES_WITH]-() } RETURN count(DISTINCT s) A; denominator: MATCH (s:ServiceBulletin) RETURN count(s) AS n

form_1_coverage.plain_explanation: Share of serialised components with release evidence — either an explicit Form 1 RELEASES edge OR mention on a CRS / task-card / Form-1 page. CL650 corpora typically tag releases as CRS rather than form_one; both satisfy the airworthiness-release intent.
form_1_coverage.justification: Derived from graph state. numerator: MATCH (c:Component)-[:HAS_SN]->(:SerialNumber) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (:Form1)-[:RELEASES]->(c) } OR EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:MENTIONED_ON]->(p:Page) WHERE p.document_type IN ['certificate_of_release_to_ser; denominator: MATCH (c:Component)-[:HAS_SN]->(:SerialNumber) RETURN count(DISTINCT c) AS n

task_compliance_complete.plain_explanation: Share of task-card pages carrying signature evidence (a stamp). Task cards without a sign-off are open work from the buyer's perspective; a stamp on the page is the corpus's signal that the task was accomplished.
task_compliance_complete.justification: Derived from graph state. numerator: MATCH (p:Page) WHERE p.document_type IN ['mis_task_card', 'routine_task_card', 'job_card'] AND EXISTS { MATCH (p)-[:HAS_STAMP]->(:Stamp) } RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS n; denominator: MATCH (p:Page) WHERE p.document_type IN ['mis_task_card', 'routine_task_card', 'job_card'] RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS n

overall.plain_explanation: Overall graph quality score: the equal-weight average of the six percentage inputs above. Per the team's checklist, only percent items feed the overall score; Yes/No and counts are excluded.
overall.computation: average(documents_complete.percent=80.0, component_data_complete.percent=31.49, ad_compliance_complete.percent=87.86, sb_compliance_complete.percent=86.66, form_1_coverage.percent=38.23, task_compliance_complete.percent=84.67) = 68.15
